skills.name: Schneiden
lines: Skill automatically used for 3 actions (does not consume MP), unless interrupted by status effect.
* 1st and 2nd Action: Earth type slash attack on all enemies x2 (XL) + Restore all party members HP +1000 + Critical Rate on user +100% (1 move).
* 3rd Action: Earth type slash attack on a single enemy (XL) + Restore all party members HP +2000 and stack 1 Heirat on user.
